items.t: Happy Thanksgiving! What are you bringing?
items.z: 感恩节快乐！你带什么菜来？

items.t: I'm on pie duty this year.
Are you doing anything for the Fourth?
We're hosting this year, so come hungry.
items.z: 今年我们家做东，空着肚子来。

items.t: Can I bring anything?
Just bring yourself.
It's a potluck, so everyone brings a dish.
items.z: 是百乐餐，每人带一道菜。

items.t: Let's do a Secret Santa this year.
items.z: 今年我们玩神秘圣诞老人吧。

items.t: What's the spending limit on gifts?
Merry Christmas! Or Happy Holidays, if you prefer.
items.z: 圣诞快乐！或者说节日快乐。

items.t: We're doing fireworks at the lake.
Trick or treat!
What are you going as for Halloween?
Happy New Year! Any resolutions?
items.z: 新年快乐！有什么新年目标吗？

items.t: Thanks for having us.
It was so good to see everyone.
Let's take a group photo before people leave.
items.z: 趁大家还没走，拍张合照吧。

items.t: Drive safe. Text me when you get home.
items.z: 开车小心，到家发个消息。

items.t: We should do this more often.
Save me some leftovers!
